items.source: AggregationOperation that exposes ExposedFields that can be used for later aggregation pipeline AggregationOperations. A FieldsExposingAggregationOperation implementing the FieldsExposingAggregationOperation.InheritsFieldsAggregationOperation will expose fields from its parent operations. Not implementing FieldsExposingAggregationOperation.InheritsFieldsAggregationOperation will replace existing exposed fields.
items.translation: 提供 ExposedFields 的AggregationOperation，这些字段可用于后续的聚合管道 AggregationOperation。实现 FieldsExposingAggregationOperation 且同时实现 FieldsExposingAggregationOperation.InheritsFieldsAggregationOperation 的操作将继承其父操作的字段；若不实现 FieldsExposingAggregationOperation.InheritsFieldsAggregationOperation，则现有暴露的字段将被替换。

items.source: Marker interface for AggregationOperation that inherits fields from previous operations.
items.translation: 继承自先前操作的字段的AggregationOperation标记接口。
托马斯·达里蒙特，马克·帕卢赫

items.source: true to conditionally inherit fields from previous operations.
items.translation: 真实地有条件地从先前操作中继承字段。
